data_description.auto_travel_times: The zApp switches a blind off when it reaches its end stop. A full run from one end to the other that nobody stopped therefore lasted exactly the travel time; it is taken over automatically.

blind_up_step.name: Blind step up
blind_up_step.description: Moves the blind one step up (option step duration, default 250 ms); with slats this turns them one step.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the step in milliseconds (100-32000); without it the option step duration applies.

blind_step_up.name: Blind step up (blind_step_up)
blind_step_up.description: Same as blind_up_step, under the name used by the HomersDroid fork.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the step in milliseconds (100-32000); without it the option step duration applies.

blind_down_step.name: Blind step down
blind_down_step.description: Moves the blind one step down (option step duration, default 250 ms); with slats this turns them one step.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the step in milliseconds (100-32000); without it the option step duration applies.

blind_step_down.name: Blind step down (blind_step_down)
blind_step_down.description: Same as blind_down_step, under the name used by the HomersDroid fork.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the step in milliseconds (100-32000); without it the option step duration applies.

blind_recall_s1.name: Recall blind scene S1
blind_recall_s1.description: Recalls scene S1 of the blind.

blind_recall_s2.name: Recall blind scene S2
blind_recall_s2.description: Recalls scene S2 of the blind.

blind_recall_s3.name: Recall blind scene S3
blind_recall_s3.description: Recalls scene S3 of the blind.

blind_recall_s4.name: Recall blind scene S4
blind_recall_s4.description: Recalls scene S4 of the blind.

blind_store_scene.name: Store blind scene
blind_store_scene.description: Stores the blind's current position on the zApp as scene S1-S4 (same as holding the scene key). Stop the blind at the wanted position first.

blind_calibrate.name: Calibrate blind
blind_calibrate.description: Calibration run, e.g. after a new blind was installed. Moves the blind fully up, down and up, measures and stores the travel times, then returns to the previous position. A notification shows the result.

light_store_scene.name: Store light scene
light_store_scene.description: Stores the light's current state (on/off and dim level) on the zApp as scene S1-S4, like holding the scene key.

light_recall_scene.name: Recall light scene
light_recall_scene.description: Recalls scene S1-S4 of the light (on/off and dim level as stored on the zApp).

program_smartbutton.name: Program Smartbutton
program_smartbutton.description: Programs a Smartbutton of a zApp with commands (same as the zeptrion app). The Smartbuttons blink; press the one to program within the wait time. Its previous programme is replaced and cannot be read back. Notifications show progress and result.

device_id.name: zApp
device_id.description: The zApp (wall device) whose Smartbutton is programmed.

actions.name: Commands
actions.description: List of blinds or lights of any zApp, each with entity_id and command, e.g. entity_id cover.play_blind with command recall_s1. Commands: on, off, toggle, stop, open, close, recall_s1-recall_s4, dim_up, dim_down, move_open, move_close, and timed move_open_1500, move_close_1500, dim_up_1500, dim_down_1500 (time in ms).

requests.name: HTTP requests
requests.description: Additional HTTP requests in the Feller format (req, loc, pth, typ, hdr, prt, bdy), e.g. for other devices. At most about 560 bytes in total.

write_name_to_zapp.name: Write name to zApp
write_name_to_zapp.description: Writes the name shown in Home Assistant (and the area as group) into the zApp, so the zeptrion app shows it too. At most 32 bytes each; longer names are cut.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name to write; empty = the device name shown in Home Assistant.

group.name: Group
group.description: Group (room) to write; empty = the area of the device.

nothing_selected.message: No Zeptrion Air blind or light selected.

smartbutton_invalid.message: The Smartbutton programme cannot be written: {error}

store_position_unknown.message: {entity}: position unknown. Move the blind fully up, then to the wanted position, then store scene S{scene}.
